evidence.quote: the Committee has embraced the view that the equilibrium level of the federal funds rate is currently below its pre-crisis level and expects the funds rate to return only gradually to its longer-run value.
This view is a key aspect of many Committee participants' reaction functions, including mine.
This language shows that the Committee has moved away from the time-based guidance of the crisis years.
Fan charts could help emphasize that the economic outlook is uncertain, and that consequently there is considerable uncertainty around the path of policy.

parsed.rationale: The speech is a discussion of forward guidance communication practices with little view on the outlook. The only policy signal is the speaker's endorsement of a low equilibrium rate and a gradual return to the longer-run value, a mild dovish lean.
